name: 表示文字とURLを分けて挿入するリンク編集
prompt:
Create a faithful compact Japanese link-entry dialog matching native LH03-0158. Keep the canvas exactly 390:212 and show only the dialog on a white outer background; do not include the dimmed Slack screen, keyboard or status bar.

Match the native geometry: a soft light-gray rounded dialog at x≈32, y≈8, width≈326, height≈188. Center the bold dark heading 「リンクを追加」 near the top. Below it, place one white rounded input group at x≈48, y≈66, width≈294, height≈76, split into two equal horizontal rows with a thin divider:
- placeholder 「表示する文字」
- placeholder 「リンク先のURL」

Both fields are empty. Keep these placeholders muted gray, not blue. There is no entered link text or clickable hyperlink in this dialog.

At the bottom, show a light-gray action row separated from the input group, with a thin vertical divider between two equal buttons. Place 「キャンセル」 on the left and 「保存」 on the right, both in the native dark-green action color. Keep the typography small and calm, preserve the generous white margin, simple borderless input surfaces, and native corner radii.

Do not add text values, URLs, blue text, icons, shadows, extra labels, background content, keyboard or other controls. The original Slack screenshot provides dialog semantics only; the native preview is authoritative for the isolated Japanese modal and all layout details.
reviewNotes: 第1版を目視。見出し、空の2項目入力、薄い区切り線、緑のキャンセル/保存とgray placeholdersを保持。実際の入力値/リンク文字はないため青文字は追加しない。native 390x212比で外枠上端は約y19（native y8）と低く、外枠高は約179（native188）で短い。入力群も約6px下、操作区切りは約5px下。needs-correctionで保持。所有者受入・実動作・編集可能性は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
